verdict.rationale: The pack confirms that Unleash has backend SDKs that connect with backend tokens and a call site like `unleash.isEnabled(...)`. Nothing in it states that server SDKs cache the ruleset and evaluate flags in-process without a network call per check. Unleash Edge, a separate caching layer and read replica that evaluates targeting within the Edge node, is a different component and earns no credit for SDK-local evaluation.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, my server SDKs evaluate flags locally from a cached ruleset — microsecond decisions with no network call per flag check
